blocks.markdown: The reviewed Mac CI correction is in [PR 183](https://github.com/ewq100/brn-rust/pull/183), with required checks running. A parallel recovery test reproduced a separate problem: an unsent draft can disappear from view after a note creates its first writing conversation and the app reopens. A focused repair is underway; no owner data or live AI call was used.
Last refreshed: **20 October 2026 at 15:02 Europe/Tallinn**. This is a saved progress summary, not live activity.

- **Completion and Undo checked:** [PR182](https://github.com/ewq100/brn-rust/pull/182) is merged after independent review and all four required pre-merge checks passed. It extends the existing desktop journey to confirm completion, verify its saved evidence, and undo that exact change. Checks on the resulting main version are still running; actual Mac interaction remains separate.

- **Unsent draft recovery repair:** an actual first-comment flow followed by a fresh app view reproduced an empty composer instead of the exact multiline Unicode draft. The original failure is saved; a focused persistence correction is being implemented. Existing search and ordinary conversation-switching checks did not reveal another actionable defect.

1. Verify [PR183](https://github.com/ewq100/brn-rust/pull/183) through the required checks before normal integration. It preserves every check, saves new shared caches only from main and gives the Mac job a bounded60-minute allowance. Independent review passed; no future speedup is claimed yet. The Project/Trash source audit found no actionable defect.

**No decision is needed from you now.** The draft recovery failure is reproduced on synthetic data; its repair and verification are pending. PR 183 awaits required checks and normal integration; PR 182’s resulting-main checks are still running. Optional Windows failures remain recorded. Actual Mac interaction stays in the 18:00 Tallinn batch.
